request: Analyze GSE257540 and GSE281241 for PMID 39523700 (Actuating Extracellular Matrices Decouple the Mechanical and Biochemical Effects of Muscle Contraction on Motor Neurons.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Transcriptomic effect on HB9::GFP mESC-derived motor neuron spheroids of (a) biochemical stimulation with conditioned medium from optogenetically exercised C2C12 muscle (1 Hz light, 30 min/day) or from spontaneously twitching (unstimulated) muscle, versus unconditioned control medium, and (b) mechanical stimulation by magnetic matrix actuation (MagMA) versus non-actuated MagMA controls (S2.4.p1-p4, FIG7, S4.6, S4.7).
planned_contrasts: Mechanical stimulation vs mechanical control (FIG7i; S2.4.p4: only 2 significant hits, both up)

biochemical: Spontaneous twitch CM (GEO: Low intensity biochem, NE1-6)
Exercise CM (GEO: High intensity biochem, S1-6)

final.sample_inclusion: QC exclusion of samples with <500K reads, rRNA >20% or exon/intron ratio <10 (n = 5, S4.10.p1); final n: control 5, spontaneous 4, exercise 4 (FIG7a); mechanical control 3, mechanical 4 (FIG7i)
final.repeated_measure_unit: not_reported (independent spheroid wells; no pairing described)
final.normalization: DESeq2 size factors; log TPM for visualization only (S4.10.p1)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 (R 4.2.0) Wald test, normal prior and ashr LFC shrinkage, BH-adjusted p (S4.10.p1); GSEA 3.0 on LFC/Wald stat vs MSigDB c2-c6 v7.0 (S4.11.p1)
final.paper_results: 194 DEGs across the biochemical comparisons (union, FIG7b; S2.4.p3); mechanical vs control: 2 DEGs, both up, RNA-degradation markers (S2.4.p4); named up genes in Exercise and Spontaneous: Ntn1, Iqgap1, Wls, Lamb1, Itgb1, Serpinh1; Exercise only: Sema3b, Sema3d, Cdh1, Lamc1, Nid1, Nid2, Bgn, Col18a1, Aebp1, Loxl1
final.GSE281241_in_paper: not_reported: the paper text cites only GSE257540 (S4.8.p2, DA.p1); GSE281241 is linked to PMID 39523700 in GEO (same SuperSeries GSE281242) and compares unstimulated ChR2 vs WT C2C12 muscle.
